build_fconv_self_att_model: build a fairseq FConvModelSelfAtt encoder-decoder model with convolutional layers and self-attention for sequence transduction
build_fconv_encoder: build an FConvEncoder convolutional encoder with token embeddings positional embeddings and optional self-attention layers
build_fconv_decoder: build an FConvDecoder convolutional decoder with linearized convolutions multi-head attention and optional self-attention
build_self_attention_module: build a SelfAttention module using DownsampledMultiHeadAttention with query key and value projections and layer normalization
configure_fconv_self_att_wp_architecture: configure the fconv_self_att_wp architecture with gated attention downsampling and multi-head self-attention for weakly supervised pretraining
